module: Rally note style 'English enthusiast': full English co-driver, with 1 to 6 numbering (one_to_six), distance calls enabled (english/distance), corner lengths, shapes (opens, tightens, over crest, etc.), descriptors (flat, square, hairpin, open/tight hairpin, bare), cautions and all the modifiers of the english/modifiers file. Assembles the modules of the english folder; M.composite and M.enumerate point to compositorUtil.
notes: File WARNING: any change to a string used for a note requires regenerating the audio files.
The 'bare' descriptor has an empty text: it is used to call a corner without an intensity word (label 'bare').
Shapes: opens, tightens, opensOverCrest, opensAndTightens, overCrest (variant '2'), tightensDown, tightensOverCrest, tightensAndOpens; some have no visual.
Fields are documented as read by textCompositor and styleValidator; validation is done at load time.

visualGeneral.desc: General colors of the visual notes (english/visual).

componentTypes.desc: corner (one_to_six numbering, left/right direction, shapes, descriptors), caution (english/caution) and modifiers (english/modifiers).
